A key part of the role is taking technical ownership of the infrastructure that underpins our Design Studio. You’ll use utilisation and usage data to help us make better decisions about renewals, investment and future capability. This isn’t just about keeping the lights on. Automation, data and AI Workplace Technology is about improving how people work as well as supporting the underlying technology. The Candidate You’ll have demonstrable experience working in IT support and infrastructure roles and be comfortable taking ownership of technical problems through to resolution. Why this role? This is a particularly broad infrastructure position. Rather than being limited to reactive IT support, you'll be encouraged to find the things that slow people down and improve them. If you enjoy being hands-on with technology while having the freedom to improve how it is used, we’d love to hear from you. Your work will be essential in safeguarding the security and reliability of our control systems, driving innovation and safety across the industry. Implement and verify cybersecurity measures such as system hardening, network segmentation, firewall configuration, secure switch configuration and log forwarding. Work with Windows-based systems, including domain-joined clients and servers, and support secure integration with the surrounding IT/OT environment.
